title: HAProxy 3 before 3.4.6 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service (persistent worker-thread…
description: HAProxy versions before 3.4.6, including version 3.0, contain a vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service by triggering a persistent worker-thread issue. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-835. No CVSS score or detailed technical exploitation information is provided. No known exploits are reported in the wild. There is no explicit vendor advisory or patch link available in the provided data.
